name: AI Medicine blind research benchmark
common_prompt: Using information available on or before 2026-11-13, identify which of these 13 AI-medicine-related public companies deserve priority research for a 5-10 year horizon. Separate potential from evidence, cite every material numeric claim, include counter-evidence, valuation assumptions, catalysts, falsifiers and a clear action tier. Do not present investment advice or use information published after the cutoff.
blinding: Replace system names with A/B/C before human grading. Freeze every answer and source timestamp before revealing identity.
claim_boundary: The benchmark may compare transparency immediately. It must not declare predictive superiority until sufficient out-of-sample outcomes have matured.
